landing_page.hero: Full screen immersive. Video or parallax image background. Minimal text. 'Enter the Temple' CTA.
landing_page.features: Zig-zag layout with overlapping images and text. Generous whitespace.
landing_page.grid: Bento grid for 'Elements' or 'Practices'. Asymmetrical spans.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (collapsible). Top bar with greeting and current moon phase. Main content area with widgets.
dashboard.widgets: Card-based. Glassmorphism style. Dark background with subtle inner glow.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px. Gold or Muted White color.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install fonts immediately using the import_url in index.css.
2. THEME: Apply the dark theme variables to tailwind.config.js. Force 'dark' class on the html element or body.
3. ANIMATION: Install 'framer-motion' and 'lucide-react'. Use framer-motion for all entry animations.
4. COMPONENTS: Do not use default Shadcn styles. Override them with the 'glass' and 'solid' card styles defined above.
5. LAYOUT: Avoid centering everything. Use left-aligned text for body, center only for hero statements.
6. MICRO-INTERACTIONS: Add hover states to every interactive element. Buttons should scale up slightly.
7. IMAGES: Use the provided image URLs. Do not use placeholders.
8. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure text contrast. If placing text over images, use a dark gradient overlay.
9. GLOW EFFECTS: Use the 'glow' shadow defined in visual_enhancers for key elements like the 'Get Started' button or active cards.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' aesthetics (generic gradients, inter font everywhere).
Use data-testid attributes for all interactive elements.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without blur.
